verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence states a no-training policy or a training opt-out. The only relevant evidence is that LangSmith can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering, which indirectly keeps trace data out of the vendor's hands. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that customer traces and data are not used for model training, a documented opt-out control for the cloud service, and independent corroboration of the data-use policy.
